beats.say: At least fifty-four adult leopards were photographed inside the metropolis of Mumbai.
Their park spans two districts, Mumbai and Thane, in western India.
beats.cap: Draft notification: 'enclosed in the metropolis of Mumbai' · Mumbai + Thane districts

beats.say: It covers about a hundred and four square kilometres, as administered.
The British built two lakes here, Vihar and Tulsi, for drinking water.
beats.cap: Vihar + Tulsi lakes: built for Mumbai's water (park timeline: 1870)

beats.say: Later, the city corporation acquired the land draining into them, to protect it.
beats.cap: Bombay Municipal Corporation acquired the lake catchments

beats.say: In the park's own history, this is a forest kept to guard water.
beats.cap: The park's own history: a forest kept to guard water

beats.say: In nineteen eighty-one, it was renamed Sanjay Gandhi National Park.
Fifty-four leopards, in a forest the park says was kept for water.
beats.cap: 54+ adult leopards · in a forest kept for water
